key_findings: ISM v0.3 crawler produced zero program records, while v0.4 exposed official programme detail pages and the current official ISM listing confirms 3 English bachelor, 9 on-campus English master/pre-master, and 2 MBA records.

Crawler titles were normalized to official catalog names, for example 'Overview Bachelor International Management' became 'International Management' and 'Master Degree in Fashion Management' became 'Luxury, Fashion & Sales Management'.
Global page text caused crawler language noise; v0.2 uses English for the modeled English-program catalogue and does not import unrelated German-program language snippets.
MBA work-experience and English B2 requirements are high-confidence because they appear directly in program-detail candidate evidence and are supported by the official MBA listing.
known_gaps: Some master detail-page requirement sections may be expandable or partially represented in crawler evidence, so several master records keep medium requirement confidence or needs_human_review.
Distance-learning English master programs and German-only programs are visible in official listings but were outside this focused v0.2 repair scope.
Exact campus lists for several master programs were not reliably separated from global campus text in the available evidence.
Tuition and detailed fee schedules were intentionally not imported from broad crawler fee snippets.
